rows.sentence: a spaceship shoots asteroids in outer space
rows.title: Spaceship Shoots Asteroids Outer
rows.goalLine: Stop 6 waves of asteroids. Each wave is faster.
rows.controlsHint: Tap where you aim to shoot. Arrows aim, Space fires.
rows.objective: Stop 6 waves of asteroids before they reach you.

rows.title: Toss Basketballs Into Hoop
rows.controlsHint: Hold to power up, drag up or down to aim, let go to throw.
rows.objective: Hit every hoop in 87 seconds before you run out of throws.

rows.sentence: whack the moles in the garden
rows.title: Whack Moles Garden
rows.controlsHint: Tap a hole to whack. Arrows and Space work too.
rows.objective: Whack 30 moles as they pop up, but spare the bunnies.
